workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it

a span: 'side' box between a heading and its first paragraph gives that paragraph a first-line indent despite indentAfterHeading: false (gotcha side-box-after-heading), so every side box follows a paragraph

a no-break space still breaks the line (gotcha nbsp-breaks: the rich measurer splits words at any whitespace, U+00A0 included, whichever line breaker runs), so the Spanish sample spells out the thousands it would join with one

a span: 'side' figure stacks from the head of the channel without making room for the opener's page-anchored kicker and numeral, and is painted over them, so the opener page cites no margin figure before the objectives box has filled the channel's head
config.locale does not localise Figure: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand

col() writes the hex beside each paletteId, because 1.4.1 paints design elements (kicker, numeral, rule, standfirst, running heads, drop folio) and bodyText.referenceColor from the hex, never from the palette (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
hyphenation matches exact codes only, so the config sets locale: t({ en: 'en-us', es: 'es' }) (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
